I selected the pasta and presence bookmarks, clicked **Add tags**, typed "wo," picked **Work**, and applied — and both came away carrying **Work** now, while keeping the tags they already had (the pasta kept Recipes, and presence kept Reading). Nothing got wiped in the process. And it told me how many it changed, which is the reassurance I'd want when acting on a group — so I know it did what I asked to all of them, not just some. I also noticed the action bar now carries the fuller range I asked about — Save for later and, when it's relevant, delete — alongside tagging and archiving, which is good to see. This does the batch-tagging job well.
